messages:
maria (Sales): Uploaded Meridian Health SIG/CAIQ (https://files.redwood/meridian/sig-caiq-2026.pdf). They need the questionnaire + supporting evidence for procurement. POC demo Mon 3/29. Can security own this intake and give an ETA?

governance-bot: New doc uploaded by maria: https://files.redwood/meridian/sig-caiq-2026.pdf

tom (Security): I'll take this. Quick Q — do they require EU-only hosting or just contractual language?

maria (Sales): EU-only data residency + token retention policy requested. POC will use demo data (no PHI), but procurement will want SOC2 scope later.

anya (Support): Can you attach a simple data flow diagram? I can help map endpoints and redact customer specifics.

derek (Eng): Heads-up — EU-only → Dedicated or Private deployment likely. Also need to confirm whether they'll send any real user PII in the POC. That affects masking and retention answers.

maria (Sales): They've said they'll avoid PII for the demo. I'll confirm and report back.

tom (Security): Triage summary for Meridian intake: high-priority SIG items we need evidence for: encryption at rest (config + screenshot), KMS integration details, MFA for admin console, vulnerability scanning cadence, incident response contact, data retention policy, subprocessors list. Plan: preliminary answers + evidence links in 48h, full package in 5 business days. Assigning owners: tom (owner), anya (evidence gathering), derek (technical answers). @lexi (Legal) FYI for any contractual caveats.

lexi (Legal): Please do not upload keys, credentials, or customer secrets. Redact any customer identifiers in screenshots. I can do a quick legal review of the final bundle before it goes to the customer.

anya (Support): I'll pull screenshots for admin MFA settings, vulnerability scan reports, and the runbook excerpts. Which environment should I screenshot (prod/demo)?

tom (Security): Use the internal demo tenant only — no prod secrets. Upload artifacts to the shared intake folder: https://drive.redwood/security/intakes/meridian-1847654321

tom (Security): Draft answers uploaded: https://drive.redwood/security/intakes/meridian-1847654321/draft-answers.md

tom (Security): Quick snippet of status:
```
Answered: 34/614
Evidence links: 4/10
Blockers: clarification on PII, confirmation of EU region capability
ETA: prelim 48h, final 5bd
```

maria (Sales): Thanks — I will confirm PII & EU hosting with the customer today and share any SOC2 cert requests. Please flag anything that would block Monday's demo.

tom (Security): Noted. If procurement asks for SOC2, we reference our certs here: https://compliance.redwood/soc2. Also will need to prepare a short vendor risk summary for their procurement team.

maria (Sales): Closing loop — customer confirmed POC will use synthetic data. I'll upload their signed DPA once I have it. Will update this thread by EOD.

governance-bot: Thread marked: intake-assigned to tom. :white_check_mark:
